correctness.rationale: For positive-degree vertices S_v T_v=0 and both marginals equal a_v=2^{-d_v}. For nonadjacent distinct vertices the disjoint incident-edge events are independent; for adjacent u,v, the joint source-at-u sink-at-v event requires the shared arrow u→v, giving 2a_ua_v and covariance a_ua_v. Sum both ordered pairs per edge to obtain the formula. Replacing uv by u−w−v keeps old degrees, removes 2a_ua_v, adds (a_u+a_v)/2 and the degree-two self-term −1/16; the sign cases d_min=1,2,3,≥4 are disjoint and exhaustive. The regular case follows by m=nr/2 and (3)–(4), with r=3 positive 5n/64 and r=4 negative −n/256. Separately checked exact-rational signs for integer degree pairs 1..13 and r values 2..15. Isolates contribute only deterministic constants and may be removed without changing covariance. No conditioning on acyclicity is used.
